# Files under data/ whose name carries a date more than 2 days ahead, on purpose (Nov 4, 2026).
# Anything else dated that far ahead is a test's made-up day written into a real checkout
# (data/daily-sent/2099-01-01.json reached main that way). Read by the commit guard every job
# installs (.github/actions/engine/engine.sh hook) and by test/future-dated-data.test.mjs.
# One line each: <path> <reason>. A path ending in / covers every file in that folder.
# A real forecast or schedule file goes here with its reason, in the PR that adds it.
